items.title: Melba Liston — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Yeah, it was. And Dusty Fletcher. He and Dusty Fletcher had a run all the time.

ctx.x: That must have been an education, working with him.
Yeah, it was. And Dusty Fletcher. He and Dusty Fletcher had a run all the time. Singers – I can’t remember all the singers.
What’s the girl who was with Lucky Millinder, married Marl Young? Didn’t she sing – I saw her there. Not Joya Sherill.
